sourceHeader.time: 1 Reaction, which you take when a hostile creature you can see moves within 10 feet of you.
sourceHeader.keywords: Hijutsu, Ninjutsu, Genjutsu (Inhale, Tactile), Shin Branch

system.description:
When a creature moves close enough, you are able to trigger your trap, releasing a thick smog of smoke from your body, forming a smokescreen that both masks you and your allies movements, but also is harmful to breathe. You spew a thick cloud of dense black smoke that forms as a 10-foot radius cloud centered on you, that lasts until the end of your next turn, forcing the triggering creature to make a Constitution saving throw.

Critical Success: No further effect

Success: Affected creature becomes Dazzled and treats the smoke as light obscurement until the end of the current turn

Failure: Affected creatures gains 2 ranks of Dazzled until the end of the current turn, and treats the smoke as light obscurement for its duration.

Critical Failure: Same as failure, but the smoke causes them to enter a Stupor for its duration.

Shin-Seal: If an affected creature has a Shin Seal, you can dispel it. If you do, on a failure, they are also Blinded until the end of their next turn.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above C-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and increase the size of the smoke cloud and the range in which a creature needs to be to cast this jutsu by +5 feet.
